newsitem.title: USA: Domenici - budget agreement chances are finished.
newsitem.headline: Domenici - budget agreement chances are finished.

text.p: The chairman of the Senate Budget Committee said Thursday he felt the chances of negotiating a budget agreement between Republicans and the White House are finished.
Sen. Pete Domenici, a New Mexico Republican, also said he saw no alternative to a five-year freeze on discretionary spending.
"I believe a chance of getting a negotiated budget between the Republicans and the president are finished," Domenici said at an Appropriations hearing on energy programs.
"It seems to me we are left no alternative other than to freeze discretionary appropriations for five years," he said.
Domenici complained that at this Appropriations hearing and others he heard more of White House plans to increase spending for various programs than for cuts.
